_task: Finding-B search — residual removed-CA-era content vs current no-CA open trust model (ADR-038/039/040)
_method: grep discovery + Read ground-truth (NOTE: Bash rg output only; -r flag is --replace, so file/line accurate, snippets verified via Read)
_boundary: REMOVE/REWRITE = removed CA content (operator certificate, certificate chain, BANZA CA, issuing keys for operator certs, certificate-as-admission, entity-level certification, INV-TRUST-001..007 as live, /certificates issued-cert route, root cert as licence, approval-based trust). PRESERVE = surviving trust (Trust Root, Signed Protocol Metadata, signatures, hashes, key manifest, key lifecycle, threshold ceremony, custody, revocation-as-crypto, trust evaluation, public verifiability, INV-OTE-*/INV-FEDEVAL-*/INV-ROOT-*).
_canonical_survivors: INV-OTE-001..010 (ADR-038), INV-FEDEVAL-001..010 (ADR-040), INV-ROOT-001..006 (ADR-038 survivor). REMOVED: INV-TRUST-001..007 (superseded in full by ADR-038), operator certificate, /.well-known/banza/certificate.json, certificate_url, certification_level as granted status.
_counts_note: Values are the number of ACTIONABLE (REMOVE/REWRITE/REVIEW) finding entries touching each gate. Several entries group many files/occurrences; see *_occurrences for underlying raw evidence. All five gates must reach 0 after M2.19B remediation.

counts_occurrences.legacy_trust_invariants: 267 INV-TRUST-001..007 occurrences across ~60 files (spec/federation, contracts, MATRIX, security, reference, engines, query-core, banzai-api) + INV-TRUST-CA-001/ROOT-001/SEAT-001
